"Create a 2D side-scrolling action survival game in HTML5 Canvas with mobile touch-friendly controls.

Player @COMMENT_BODY@ Movement:
- Player controls a Ukrainian soldier automatically or manually running right through a war zone.
- Controls: Touch buttons on screen for abilities, plus jump/dodge controls.

Status @COMMENT_BODY@ UI:
- Health Bar: Displays current HP.
- Distance Bar: Starts at 5,000m (5 km) and counts down to 0m as the player advances.
- 3 Ability Buttons on UI (with visible cooldown timers):
  1. REB (EW Jammer): Causes all active enemy drones on screen to instantly lose control and explode.
  2. Radio: Calls a friendly FPV drone strike that destroys all ground enemies on screen.
  3. Medkit: Restores a portion of the player's HP.

Enemies @COMMENT_BODY@ Threats:
- Sky: Enemy attack drones flying from above and diving/shooting at the player.
- Ground: Enemy infantry running from the right towards the player.

Ending / Victory Condition:
- When distance reaches 0m, the scrolling stops, and a friendly \"Novator\" armored vehicle appears with comrades firing cover support.
- When player reaches the vehicle, show a victory screen/animation of the team hopping in and driving off.

Visual Style:
- Gritty 2D battlefield atmosphere, clear UI buttons, readable sprites for mobile screen.
"

## Objective
- Build a polished, mobile-touch-friendly 2D side-scrolling Ukrainian battlefield survival game in HTML5 Canvas, with 5 km extraction run, abilities, enemies, and Novator victory sequence.

## Requirements
- Player controls a Ukrainian soldier auto-running or manually right through a war zone; touch jump/dodge controls.
- HUD: health bar, distance bar starting at 5,000 m counting to 0 m, 3 ability buttons with visible cooldowns.
- Abilities: REB jammer destroys all on-screen drones; Radio calls FPV strike destroying all on-screen ground enemies; Medkit restores HP.
- Enemies: diving/shooting attack drones from sky; infantry running from right.
- At 0 m scrolling stops; friendly “Novator” armored vehicle arrives with comrades firing cover; player reaches vehicle and victory animation shows team boarding/driving off.
- Gritty 2D battlefield atmosphere, readable mobile sprites, clear UI.

## Decisions
- Implemented as static `index.html`, `styles.css`, `game.js` with all visuals procedurally drawn on canvas; no external assets.
- Added auto-fire and automatic running alongside touch/keyboard jump/dodge.
- Initial ability cooldowns: REB 16s, Radio 22s, Medkit 28s.
- Game duration approx. 80–90 seconds; extraction phase auto-runs player to Novator, boarding animation, drive-off, then overlay.
- Start button uses `aria-label="Play"` so capture auto-start recognizes it.
- Added synthesized WebAudio sound effects and mute button.
- Decided to increase sprite scale/visibility and brighten battlefield after visual review.
